item.title: 2027: Police will not be used as Political Tool – IGP
item.description: By Edwin Philip Abuja -The Inspector-General of Police (IGP) Olatunji Dusu has assured Nigerians that the Nigeria Police Force (NPF) will not serve as a political tool ahead of the 2027 general elections. Dusu was speaking on Tuesday at the day 2 of 2027 edition of Media Development Conference, organised by Centre for Journalism Innovation and Development (CJID) taking place at the Abuja Continental Hotel, Dusu emphasised that policing is anchored on public trust and accountability rather than force. ​Expressing commitments ahead of the 2027 elections, the IGP stated that the Nigeria Police Force will be guided by professionalism, neutrality, and accountability to all Nigerians, political parties, and the law. ​He said “Any police officer found to be partisan, to have taken sides, or to have aided any candidate or the party will face disciplinary action under the force’s code of conduct”. ​Addressing grievances surrounding the alleged misuse of the Cybercrime Law against journalists, Dusu pledged that the police under his leadership will not be a willing tool for oppression in the hands of politically motivated actors. He warned that elections can now be disrupted through the information environment—via fake videos, doctored audio, coordinated social media falsehoods, and fabricated stories capable of triggering real-world violence. Responding during the panel session which was on ‘People centred public safety and State policing in Nigeria’, the Nigerian Police boss, said that Nigerians should not be afraid of the State Governors misusing the State policing system, he assured that safeguards are being developed to ensure state police structures are not hijacked for personal or political interests, including provisions for federal intervention if situations get out of hand. IGP noted that the National Assembly, and the nation are working to design a framework suited specifically to Nigeria’s realities rather than copying foreign models, emphasising that police training will be standardised across the country so that officers in states such as Lagos and Kano undergo uniform training standards regardless of differing local functions. On the enforcement of the Cybercrime Act, the IGP disclosed that the force has held two symposiums since his assumption of office to examine cybercrime laws and digital offenses. He urged citizens and media practitioners to familiarize themselves with the provisions of the Act, noting that actions often perceived as minor online can constitute offenses under the law. He added that personnel posted to the NPF cyber section are being trained and equipped to tackle emerging digital crimes. IGP Dusu affirmed that journalism is not a crime and described journalists as essential partners in progress and development who hold governments accountable. While acknowledging that press freedom in Nigeria is relatively better than in some neighbouring countries in the Sahel region, he noted there is still room for improvement on both

item.title: Augsburg boss Manuel Baum handed touchline ban for Hoffenheim clash
item.description: Augsburg boss Manuel Baum handed touchline ban for Hoffenheim clash FC Augsburg have confirmed that head coach Manuel Baum will serve a one-match touchline ban following his dismissal during Sunday's 3-1 victory over Mainz. Baum was shown a straight red card by referee Martin Petersen shortly before half-time after delaying a Mainz throw-in. The DFB's sports court has subsequently handed the 47-year-old a one-match ban for unsporting conduct, meaning he will be absent from the dugout when Augsburg travel to Hoffenheim on Sunday. The suspension comes into effect 30 minutes before kick-off and remains in place until 30 minutes after the final whistle. During this period, Baum will be prohibited from entering the dressing room, players' tunnel and technical area, as well as communicating with his players or coaching staff, either directly or indirectly. Both Baum and Augsburg have accepted the ruling, meaning the decision is final. The Fuggerstädter will be looking to build on Sunday's victory over Mainz, which brought an end to a seven-match winless run in the Bundesliga.

item.title: Police arrest 11 suspected yahoo boys in Ogun, recover charms
item.description: By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta The Police Special Fraud Unit (PSFU), under FCID Alagbon, has arrested 11 suspected internet fraudsters during an intelligence-led raid on an alleged cybercrime hideout, popularly known as a “Yahoo academy,” in Abeokuta, Ogun State. The operation also led to the recovery of suspected fetish materials, including charms, blood-stained items and suspected human remains, alongside 11 iPhones, three Samsung mobile phones, eight laptops and a 2014 Lexus RX 350. The suspects were reportedly arrested at House 10, Second Hill Estate, Oloke-Meji, Onikolobo, Abeokuta, following investigations by detectives of the police unit. According to the police, the suspects were allegedly members of an organised internet fraud network known as “Hustle Kingdom”, which operated from the apartment and used the facility as a base for cyber-enabled fraud and other criminal activities. The Police Public Relations Officer of the PSFU, DSP Ovie Ewhubare, disclosed this in a statement made available to newsmen, saying preliminary investigations indicated that the suspects exploited the identities and personal information of foreign nationals to defraud unsuspecting victims online. The statement identified the arrested suspects as Adedolapo Samuel, 25; Timothy Babatunde, 27; Ibrahim Sholete, 30; Torioza Oluwatosin, 30; Yusuf Alabi, 30; Adeyemi Seyi, 32; Tobiloba Oguntoyinbo, 32; Taiwo Mathew, 23; Shoyombo Ayomide, 24; Abayomi Rahmon, 32; and Abolaji Tunji, 28. It, however, disclosed that the alleged leader of the group, identified as Goriola Oluwaseun Olanrewaju, popularly known as “Update”, was still at large. The police said Olanrewaju allegedly rented the property in 2021 before recruiting young men into the criminal network. The statement read in part: “Investigations revealed that one Goriola Oluwaseun Olanrewaju ‘M’, also known as Update, currently at large, rented the apartment in 2021 and subsequently recruited young men into an organised internet fraud operation, commonly known as a ‘Hustle Kingdom’, where they use the facility as a base for cyber-related fraud and other criminal activities. “The suspects admitted that they exploit the identities and personal details of foreign nationals to defraud unsuspecting victims online.” Reacting to the development, the Commissioner of Police, Eloho Okpoziakpo, said the operation underscored the importance of credible information, intelligence-led policing and professional investigative skills in tackling organised financial crimes and other cyber-enabled offences. Okpoziakpo said investigations were ongoing to establish the circumstances surrounding the occupation of the property and determine whether its owners had discharged their responsibilities by verifying the identities of their tenants and monitoring activities on the premises. item.title: Barberton basketball great, part of 1976 title team Mark Bodnar dies
item.description: Marty Bodnar always knew where his twin brother Mark was on the basketball court, and vice versa. Together, that brotherly intuition helped them lead Barberton — along with Carter Scott, who with the Bodnars formed one of the original Big 3s, before it was such a trend — to an undefeated record and a class AAA state championship in 1976. Marty and Mark were brothers, teammates, best friends and a major part of each other’s support system for more than six decades. Following a multi-year battle with cancer, Mark Bodnar died last week. He was 67 years old. The Bodnar twins were instrumental players during that legendary Barberton run along with Scott and coach Jack Greynolds. As juniors, they helped lead Barberton to a 26-0 record and the state title. They extended that winning streak to 51 games the next season, though it was eventually snapped in the 1977 state title game. During that championship run in 1976, Marty Bodnar hit a decisive basket in the closing moments to seal the win over Canton McKinley in the regional final. The assist, via a perfectly-placed bounce pass, came from his twin brother Mark, who knew exactly where to put it. “He just always knew where I was at,” Marty said, speaking to the Beacon Journal on Monday, Nov. 23. “He’s been assisting me for 67 years. I’m gonna miss him. It’s just a sixth sense we had. I dunno, I can’t explain it. “But he was there, back in those days, and he was assisting me in so many ways throughout my life, and I was assisting him.” In 2024, that '76 Barberton squad was inducted into the Ohio Basketball Hall of Fame . After the success in high school, both brothers went to play at Michigan. Marty still lives in the Ann Arbor area. A few years ago, he was asked by a friend to speak to a fifth-grade basketball team. It just so happened that former Michigan coach and current Los Angeles Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh had a son on that team. After Marty Bodnar spoke to the kids, Harbaugh walked up and asked what it was like playing with his twin brother for so long, something with which the well-known football coach has some experience due to his brother John, coach of the New York Giants, being involved at the top levels of the sport. Marty told Harbaugh that he and Mark just had a connection they couldn’t explain, and it was something they treasured. “I paused, and then I said, ‘I always knew where he was on the court, and he always knew where I was,’” Marty Bodnar said. “It was just a sixth sense. A bond that twins have.” Marty noted how appreciative the family has been to see an outpouring of messages come in from all around the country, including those with a Barberton connection. Scott, the third member of that dynamic title-winning trio, called from California to offer his condolences. It showed how close the basketball community had remained after so many years. And it showed how many people Mark had touched in a positive light. “We were just so fortunate to have a great relationship, and he was so th

item.title: Premier League Matchday 11: Three Key Takeaways As Manchester United’s Woes Continue
item.description: After the last international break of the year, the Premier League season resumed last weekend with Premier League Matchday 11. Premier League Matchday 11 began on Saturday, November 21, with Manchester City and Fulham drawing 1- 1. It ended on Monday with Brentford blowing away Everton 4-0 at home. After Premier League Matchday 11, Arsenal extended their lead at the top of the Premier League to six points over second-place Brighton & Hove Albion, despite drawing 2-2 against Newcastle United. Premier League Matchday 11 showed that some teams are taking time to return to form after the break, with unexpected results. Premier League Matchday 11 also showed that some teams still have ongoing issues they need to solve quickly before their seasons go off the rails. From shocking results to major upsets, here are the biggest takeaways from Premier League Matchday 11. Three Key Takeaways From Premier League Matchday 11 1. Manchester United Is Unrepairable After Blowout Loss To Liverpool A lot happened at Manchester United during the international break as former United States men’s manager Mauricio Pochettino replaced Michael Carrick in hopes of turning around the Red Devils’ disappointing season. While their first game under Pochettino was a tough away test at Liverpool, optimism remained that he could turn things around, given his experience at Tottenham Hotspur and his success there, despite not winning a trophy. Instead, Manchester United suffered a blowout loss to Liverpool, and none of their issues under Carrick were solved, making it even more evident that this club is unrepairable as the threat of relegation continues to grow. This horror show for the Red Devils started early, as Leny Yoro was sent off in the eighth minute for a last-gasp challenge on Alexander Isak, leaving them with 10 men for the rest of the game. Then, everything fell apart for Manchester United as they gave up two goals to Liverpool five minutes after the red card. After the goals, Pochettino had no choice but to switch to a back five to keep the game from getting out of hand, making his first substitution in the 22nd minute by bringing on Harry Maguire for Bryan Mbeumo. While the first half ended with Liverpool 2-0 up, Manchester United were lucky not to be down by more at half-time. The Reds had an expected goals rate of 1.67 as they dominated possession, while the Red Devils had a measly expected goals rate of 0.14, as Pochettino kept going to his bench for a spark. Still, nothing was working for his team as Liverpool continued to dominate before finally breaking through with two more goals, and the game ended with Liverpool running out 4-0 victors over Manchester United. Now, after Premier League Matchday 11, the Red Devils are 19th in the Premier League table with eight points, one point above last-place Crystal Palace. item.title: Como plot shock transfer move for Man Utd outcast Joshua Zirkzee after Moise Kean injury disaster
item.description: Chelsea FC v Manchester United - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Como have emerged as potential suitors for out-of-favour Manchester United forward Joshua Zirkzee ahead of the January transfer window. Cesc Fabregas' side are exploring attacking options after summer signing Moise Kean suffered a major injury setback that will sideline the Italy international for several more months. Como eye Zirkzee after Moise Kean injury blow Como have joined a growing list of Serie A clubs interested in signing Zirkzee during the January transfer window. According to Gianluca Di Marzio , the Italian side are weighing up attacking reinforcements following a major injury setback to Kean. Fabregas confirmed over the weekend that Kean faces another lengthy spell on the sidelines after aggravating an issue in training last week. The Como manager stated that the striker will be out for "another few months, not weeks", forcing the club to reassess their forward options. Recurring tibia issue sidelines Kean for months Kean has battled a recurring tibia problem for several months, an issue that predates his move to Como. Despite playing through pain earlier in the campaign, the 26-year-old has endured repeated setbacks and has not featured since representing Italy during the September-October international break. Just as he neared a return to full training, Kean suffered another fitness relapse that may now require surgical intervention. With the forward ruled out for the foreseeable future, Como are "exploring their options" in the market, though no formal negotiations have opened with Manchester United. Zirkzee struggles for minutes at Old Trafford A return to Italy could offer a lifeline to Zirkzee, who has endured a frustrating spell since arriving at Old Trafford from Bologna for an initial €42.5m in 2024. The Netherlands international has fallen down the pecking order and is yet to start a single competitive fixture for United during the 2026-27 season. Zirkzee has accumulated just 231 minutes of action across 11 substitute appearances in the Premier League, Champions League and EFL Cup. While he appeared surplus to requirements under former boss Michael Carrick, his future under new head coach Mauricio Pochettino remains uncertain. Serie A rivals monitor United forward Como are far from the only Italian club tracking Zirkzee's availability ahead of the winter window. Napoli are also reportedly keeping tabs on the Dutchman as they prepare to enter the market for a striker should Lorenzo Lucca depart the club. Zirkzee's proven track record in Serie A ensures he remains a sought-after target across the division. Alongside interest from Como and Napoli, the forward has previously been linked with moves to Juventus, Roma and Milan during his difficult stint in England.

item.title: SEC Championship Game: Paths for Alabama, Texas or Tennessee to play Georgia
item.description: ATLANTA, GEORGIA - DECEMBER 06: A view of the SEC Championship logo on the field prior to the 2025 SEC Championship between the Georgia Bulldogs and Alabama Crimson Tide at Mercedes-Benz Stadium on December 06, 2025 in Atlanta, Georgia. (Photo by Todd Kirkland/Getty Images) Todd Kirkland The 2026 SEC Championship Game will make history as the conference’s final championship game before the College Football Playoff expands to 24 teams in 2027. [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] No. 1 Georgia already punched its ticket after its win on Saturday. It will be the program’s sixth straight appearance in the championship game. But the Bulldogs are still waiting to learn their opponent with three teams in the running: No. 3 Alabama, No. 5 Texas and No. 9 Tennessee. Here’s what each team needs to happen to advance. ALABAMA MAKES SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME IF... There are two paths for the Crimson Tide. Alabama beats Auburn plus Texas loses to Texas A&M and Tennessee loses to Vanderbilt OR Alabama beats Auburn plus wins from Tennessee, LSU and Mississippi State In the second scenario, Alabama would hold the conference opponent win percentage tiebreaker, despite its loss to Tennessee. Georgia defeated Alabama back in September for its first win in Tuscaloosa since 2007. The two sides have met in the SEC Championship Game five times. TEXAS MAKES SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME IF... There are three paths for the Longhorns. Texas beats Texas A&M and Alabama loses to Auburn OR Texas beats Texas A&M and Tennessee loses to Vanderbilt OR Texas beats Texas A&M and either Mississippi State or LSU lose No matter the path, Texas has to beat Texas A&M on Friday night or it will miss out on the SEC Championship Game. And their playoff fate will be left to the College Football Playoff committee. Georgia and Texas met in the 2024 SEC Championship Game with the Bulldogs winning in overtime. TENNESSEE MAKES SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME IF... For the Vols, there is only one path to make it to the SEC Championship Game. Tennessee needs Texas A&M to beat Texas on Friday night and the Vols must beat Vanderbilt. Georgia and Tennessee did not play this season after the SEC conference schedule moved to 10 games. It’s the first time since 1991 that the Bulldogs and Vols haven’t met in a season. The two programs have never faced each other in the SEC Championship Game. WHEN IS THE SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME? The SEC Championship Game is set for Saturday, Dec. 5 with a 4 p.m. kickoff at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. The game will air on Channel 2. [SIGN UP: WSB-TV Daily Headlines Newsletter ]

‘Every night’ – Luka Doncic’s latest LA Lakers antics have left NBA fans ‘exhausted’
item.description: Photo by Ryan Sirius Sun/Getty Images Despite being one of the best players in the league, Luka Doncic can sometimes be a divisive figure in the league because of the way he approaches defenders. In particular, it is Doncic’s ability and constant efforts to draw fouls that frustrate a large portion of the fanbase, as they believe he focuses too much on getting to the free-throw line. For a player of Doncic’s offensive calibre, the fixation on trying to draw fouls does tend to hold his game back on occasion, with one example during the LA Lakers’ win over the Utah Jazz proving to be the perfect example. Luka Doncic’s eight-second violation while trying to draw a foul draws negative reactions from fans In the early stages of the Los Angeles Lakers’ win over the Utah Jazz, Luka Doncic was bringing the ball up when he found himself being picked up full-court by his former Dallas Mavericks teammate Josh Green. In an effort to draw a foul before crossing the half-court line, Doncic would end up with an eight-second violation, having not brought the ball up within eight seconds of the shot clock starting after collecting the inbound pass. Understandably, such a rookie mistake from a veteran like Doncic proved to be frustrating, especially considering many fans saw this as a blatant attempt to draw a foul rather than get a good look on the offensive end. One fan wrote: “Every night it’s something else from him. Just a whiny-a** b****. Exhausted by all of it, y’all.” Another fan added: “Watching Luka is infuriating. He’s so good; just play the f****** game you’re paid millions of dollars to play! $200/ticket to watch this? I want my money back, Adam Silver!” A third fan even observed Doncic’s extra effort to draw a foul: “Dude was loading up that head whiplash for the whistle!” A fourth fan even went as far as to say that the Dallas Mavericks were right to trade Luka Doncic: “Nico was right, man; f****** trash player!” Focusing on his performance on the night, a fifth fan called out Doncic’s woes on the offensive end: “Another inefficient night vs. one of the worst defensive teams in the league.” And lastly, one final fan claimed this reaction from Doncic was a sign of his irritation with the Lakers: “Is it me or does it seem like Luka is unhappy? He seems extremely frustrated every game!” Doncic had a remarkably poor night against the Jazz, scoring 28 points on 8/24 shooting from the field and 3/14 shooting from beyond the arc. While he did dish out eight assists, Doncic’s four personal fouls in the first half got him in trouble, and forced the Lakers to play a large portion of the second half without him, so as to not lose him later in the game. item.title: Major setback awaits JJ Gabriel at Real Madrid after highly publicised Man United exit
item.description: Major setback awaits JJ Gabriel at Real Madrid after highly publicised Man United exit JJ Gabriel is reportedly set for an immediate setback at Real Madrid following his highly controversial Manchester United exit. Acrimonious departure A week ago, Gabriel confirmed his United exit via social media, putting an end to weeks of speculation over his future. In September, he and his representatives stunned United by officially requesting the club to cancel his registration. He subsequently withdrew from training at Carrington, choosing instead to follow his own individual programme in Spain. United’s attempts to persuade him to stay went unanswered by the player’s camp. A report covered by The Peoples Person relayed that United found out about Gabriel’s exit via his social media announcement. United may still hold the teenager’s registration until the season’s end, but it will not stop him from moving to a European Union club; he now possesses an EU passport through his mother, who is of Cypriot heritage. It’s understood that Gabriel has a verbal agreement to join Madrid . The move is expected to go through at the turn of the year. However, according to the Manchester Evening News , the teenager faces an immediate problem once he signs on the dotted line. Gabriel put in his place According to the newspaper, Gabriel is set to begin his career at Real Madrid in a low-key fashion, with the Spanish giants guided by their prior experience of having Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard. Neither Castilla, Real Madrid’s B team, nor the C team may sign players before January. Source: API-Football, Transfermarkt, Wikipedia Gabriel is expected to play for the Under-18s in the interim, but upon joining Madrid he will not initially train with the first team. It could be a blow to him and his father, one of whose stated grievances for leaving United was wanting greater involvement with the senior squad. Madrid’s plan is for Gabriel to train and play for the B team. It’s understood that Madrid are eager not to repeat the mistakes they made with Odegaard a decade ago. Having been signed at the age of 15, Odegaard was rushed into the first team but struggled to secure playing time under Carlo Ancelotti and Zinedine Zidane, making it eventually necessary for him to depart the Santiago Bernabeu to preserve his career. Journalist Guillem Balague told the BBC that Madrid are also not happy with the media circus surrounding Gabriel’s switch from Old Trafford. “Madrid learned from the Martin Odegaard period that training with the first team while playing for the B side is a bad idea. So the plan is a spell in the B side, and when he is ready, Gabriel jumps straight into the first team.” “Where Madrid are less happy is with how things have unfolded.” “Madrid wanted to set the timing themselves and be discreet, because they do not want problems with Manchester United and do not want to upset anyone. item.title: RB Leipzig and PreZero extend partnership until 2029
item.description: RB Leipzig and PreZero extend partnership until 2029 RB Leipzig and PreZero have extended their partnership, which began in 2022, by a further three years until 30th June 2029 . The Neckarsulm-based company will remain an Official Supplier of the Red Bulls and continue to advise the club on matters relating to the circular economy. The two partners share a common goal: to use resources responsibly, keep materials in circulation and develop innovative ideas within football. Putting the circular economy into practice – from stadium seats to Zero Waste Two projects in particular highlight what the partnership has achieved so far: In May 2024, the Red Bull Arena’s waste and recycling management system was certified by TÜV Süd in line with DIN SPEC 91436 “Zero Waste” at Bronze maturity level. At the time, more than 85% of waste generated on the stadium grounds was already being recycled or undergoing other forms of material recovery. This rate had more than doubled since 2019. The old blue stadium seats from the Red Bull Arena have also been given a second life. As part of the “SEATainability” project, they were recycled into Soccercourt boards. Seats that once accommodated fans now serve a new purpose on a football pitch. Stephan Czieplik, Chief Revenue Officer at RB Leipzig: “We’ve achieved a great deal together with PreZero since 2022. The Zero Waste certification of our Red Bull Arena and projects such as SEATainability demonstrate what’s possible through our partnership. We want to continue developing new ideas that conserve resources while delivering tangible benefits for our club.” Discover more Fixtures Red Bull Arena Men's first team Tickets Fan Zone

item.title: The Blue Jays’ reported offer for Tarik Skubal revealed after his $450 million Mets deal
item.description: Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images Tarik Skubal has signed the largest pitching contract in MLB history with the New York Mets, but the Toronto Blue Jays put a pretty large offer on the table themselves. After a brief stint with the Los Angeles Dodgers, Tarik Skubal will now play for the New York Mets starting next season. The two-time Cy Young Award winner signed a deal worth $450 million over nine years with the franchise, comfortably surpassing Yoshinobu Yamamoto’s massive deal with his former team. Skubal has had many suitors since it became evident that he would be leaving the Detroit Tigers last year. The Dodgers got him in a trade, but it soon became clear that other teams were waiting to pounce on the pitcher in free agency. And now, the Blue Jays’ reported offer to Skubal has been revealed. The Toronto Blue Jays reportedly gave Tarik Skubal a $420 million contract offer Toronto had been among the teams competing for his signature, alongside the Mets, Dodgers and San Diego Padres. If reports are to be believed, the Dodgers never made a formal offer, and the Mets came out as the eventual winners in the sweepstakes. Toronto’s offer was reported by the New York Post’s Jon Heyman, with The Athletic’s Mitch Bannon also reporting that the Blue Jays had put more than $400 million on the table. “The Toronto Blue Jays offered Tarik Skubal $420M but the Mets topped it with $450M to seal the deal with the two-time Cy Young award winner,” the report reads. New York’s offer also reportedly includes a $45 million signing bonus and full no-trade protection, which may have tipped the scales further in their favour. The size of the contract means there will be significant pressure on Skubal moving forward. The pitcher will have to deliver for a Mets team that has so far significantly underperformed their massive payroll. As for the Blue Jays, this marks yet another failed pursuit for a big superstar. item.title: Aljamain Sterling Raises Questions Over Scoring After UFC Qatar Loss to Kevin Vallejos
item.description: Aljamain Sterling at UFC 300 | Photo: USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Connect | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Kshitiz Kumar Singh Aljamain Sterling’s move to featherweight has had its ups and downs, starting with a dominant win over Calvin Kattar, then a razor-close decision loss to Mosvar Evloev. He then bounced back with wins over Brian Ortega and Youssef Zalal, and just had a very close fight with 24-year-old contender Kevin Vallejos. At UFC Qatar , Sterling and Vallejos stifled each other’s best abilities, leading to a very contested fight round after round. The matchup between Sterling and Vallejos was extremely technical. The former bantamweight champion struggled to work in grappling and find openings, while Vallejos struggled to employ his game plan of keeping pressure and finding the knockout shot. The scorecards favored Vallejos’ action, with two judges giving him the win 30-27 and one 29-28. What does Aljamain Sterling think of the scoring in his UFC Qatar fight? Reflecting on the matchup during The Ariel Helwani Show , Aljamain Sterling said, “I’m not calling it a robbery. I just wish we could get some explanation on what they’re actually scoring.” Sterling went into detail on his questions about scoring criteria: “I know the criteria is damage, but what is damage when you’re being outstruck, and what’s damage when a guy is swinging and missing and not landing anything of significance.” Aljamain Sterling proposes a change to how fights are judged: “When the scorecards came, I thought it was going to go my way, and then when it didn’t, I was in disbelief. I was baffled. I don’t know what we’re scoring. I don’t know what scores anymore. I still think judges should be in the back room watching the fights. Why not? If you wanna progress the sport, you can’t keep changing the rules from week to week, where one thing happens, you score it this way, and then the next week you see something else scored a different way.” — Ariel Helwani (@arielhelwani) November 23, 2026 Sterling went on to give Vallejos a lot of credit, calling him the most dangerous 145-pounder. Vallejos has been on a tear in his recent fights, securing knockouts and Performance of the Night bonuses against both Giga Chikadze and Josh Emmett. Vallejos is a Contender Series alumni and his only loss of his career came against Jean Silva in their Contender Series matchup back in 2023. ALSO READ: What’s Next for Navajo Stirling After Knocking Out Jiri Prochazka at UFC Qatar? However, Sterling was able to stay at distance and did not take too many clean shots, so he does have valid questions about the scoring criteria, especially since he did narrowly outstrike the young contender in the first two rounds, went 1-14 on takedowns, and had 3:32 seconds of control time throughout the fight. While Vallejos did keep pressure on and had arguably the cleaner, more damaging strikes, Sterling still did great defensively and had the striking numbers. item.title: Rob Gronkowski is ‘a little worried’ about the Jacksonville Jaguars after what he’s noticed
item.description: Photo by Paras Griffin/Getty Images Rob Gronkowski has suggested that the Jacksonville Jaguars are starting to make him a ‘little worried’ due to their inconsistency, which he thinks was on display against the New York Giants in Week 11. The Jaguars managed just 18 points against the Giants, their lowest points total since mid-September when they were beaten 20-13 by the Denver Broncos. Despite the recent 23-18 loss to the Giants, the Jags are still comfortably top of the AFC South and look pretty nailed on for a playoff berth. However, Gronkowski is worried that Jacksonville use up all their ‘greatness’ in the regular season and then struggle in the playoffs. Rob Gronkowski suggests Jaguars are too inconsistent during playoffs Speaking to NFL on Fox , he said: “I am a little worried about the Jags because of their inconsistency. They kind of showed and displayed this last year. Yeah, they’ve got a great team and they can show greatness at times, but then they hit the playoffs, the last couple of years, and boom, they just unload in a terrible way. It’s like they unload all their greatness.” Talking specifically about the Week 11 loss, he added: “It’s like they’ve used it all up throughout the whole season, and now they’re already showing periods like this game and moments where they’re just not showing up. They’ve got to show up on a consistent basis. “It’s not like, ‘Hey, you know, the playoffs are kicking in. We’re going to dominate now. We’re going to play our best football’. You’ve got to continue to play your best football throughout the whole year, especially against solid opponents. “Like the New York Giants. Yes, they shocked everyone, but they’re a solid team. Harbaugh is a great coach, you know? They’ve got McCarthy now. They’re playing together as a team. They want to win. It’s like there are no individuals. “Everyone’s in it together with the New York Giants. I’m not saying the Jags aren’t. I mean, I feel like there aren’t any individuals on that team, but they’re just too inconsistent over the years.” The Jaguars made it to the Wild Card Playoffs in 2025, losing 27-24 against the Buffalo Bills and you could make a case that their inconsistency was on display then. Trevor Lawrence is one of the top quarterbacks in the NFL but against the Bills, he threw a game-losing interception in the final few minutes, which cost his side. Prior to that, they competed in the 2022/23 season playoffs and were bested by the Kansas City Chiefs when Nick Bolton and Jaylen Watson capitalised on fumbles and interceptions in the fourth quarter to help their team win 27-20. It does feel like the Jaguars are never really blown away when they are beaten in the postseason. Instead, individual errors or lapses in concentration seem to be what costs them. But it’s hard to predict if that will change in 2026/27, as apart from the Giants’ loss, they have looked like one of the most complete teams in the regular campaign. item.title: Temi Nkem’s Oversized Braided Updo Is the Hairstyle Inspiration We Needed
item.description: Big Brother Naija 2026 winner Temi Nkem pairs a structured matte-gold leather corset and black velvet skirt with an architectural braided updo. If your next braid appointment has you thinking beyond the usual ponytail or bun, Temi Nkem has an idea you might want to take to your hairstylist. The Big Brother Naija 2026 winner wore her thick braids in a high, sculptural updo, with oversized loops arranged into a crown. She paired it with a gold-and-black look, complete with metallic beauty details and contrasting textures. Rather than letting her thick braids fall down her back, Temi has gathered them into a sleek, high updo, building them into an oversized crown of interlocking loops. The result is sculptural, full of volume and beautifully structured. It’s also a great example of how to style thick braids when you want a fresh way to wear them for an event. Pulling the hair up keeps the face open, while the loops create plenty of interest around the crown. And with the base kept sleek, the hairstyle gets to take centre stage without feeling too busy. Temi Nkem accents her sleek looped braid updo with metallic gold-leaf detailing, brow crystal, and glossy nude lips. Then there are the beauty details. Temi goes for smoky brown eyeshadow, full lashes and a glossy nude lip outlined in brown, keeping the makeup warm and complementary to the outfit. A little gold takes things further: there’s a tiny cross-shaped crystal between her brows, three vertical micro-beads on her chin, hammered circular gold earrings and flecks of metallic gold leaf tracing the side of her face, from her left temple down to her collarbone. It’s an unexpected beauty detail, and one that ties in beautifully with the colours of her outfit. Temi Nkem shows how to style thick braids into a sculptural crown paired with a gold-and-black corset gown. Now, about that gown! Temi shows how to wear gold and black with ease, starting with a structured matte-gold leather corset bodice. It features vertical seam boning, a deep V-plunge neckline and a sharply defined V-shaped basque waist. Below it, a fitted black velvet skirt brings a different texture into the look, while matching off-the-shoulder velvet arm bands complete the silhouette. The contrast between the gold leather and plush black velvet is what makes the combination work so well. Rather than having both colours compete for attention, the matte gold adds warmth and the black velvet gives the outfit balance. So, if thick braids are next on your salon mood board, you might want to save Temi’s updo. And if you’re planning a gold-and-black outfit, her mix of leather and velvet is another styling idea worth keeping. item.title: Buffalo Bills did something ‘incredible’ with Josh Allen to ‘unleash’ him against the Chiefs
item.description: Photo by Perry Knotts/Getty Images The Thanksgiving game between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Buffalo Bills is the marquee fixture, and the latter have done something ‘incredible’ with Josh Allen to prepare him for it. When the Kansas City Chiefs take on the Buffalo Bills on Thanksgiving night, it will be a clash between two marquee quarterbacks and two winning teams. Patrick Mahomes is not surrendering his position and Josh Allen is coming for it, while this could easily be the Super Bowl game this season. To prepare Allen for this game in the best possible way, the Bills did something ‘incredible’ during their recent game against the Dolphins. Josh Allen protected against the Dolphins The Bills faced no issues dispatching the Dolphins in their recent game to go 9-1 this season and cement themselves as the best team in the NFL. Allen managed to gain 304 yards with his passing, completing 27/45 attempts, but it was a sloppy game by his usually world-class standards. NFL reporter Jordan Schultz, speaking on Ryan Clarke’s The Pivot podcast, said that Allen’s game was by design, as the Bills prioritised protecting him at all costs. Schultz said that for the first time ever, Allen took no part in any rushes, design runs, or scrambles, and that was all intentional. He said: “Something happened Sunday against Miami. And I’m looking at it right now. This is pretty incredible because I want to make sure I get this right. Josh Allen, this is the first time we’ve ever seen this in his career. He finished the game with zero rushing attempts. “No design runs, no scrambles, nothing. Everything went through the passing game or the running backs. And my understanding is that this was very strictly and deliberately by design. Buffalo wanted to make sure that Josh was fresh for Thursday, when the entire playbook will be available and he’ll be fully unleashed.” It is no surprise to see the Bills preparing this way for a game that could go a long way towards solidifying their championship prospects and placing Allen as the MVP favourite. Allen is now well-rested and safe to play to his full strengths in a game that will be watched and analysed by millions, and the Bills’ gamble will be spoken about as genius if they win that game after winning against the Dolphins as well. item.title: Champions League: Arsenal face tough Dortmund test as Man City welcome Napoli
item.description: Arsenal will face a stern test when they host Borussia Dortmund in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday, while Manchester City welcome Italian champions Napoli to the Etihad Stadium as the competition enters Matchday Five. The two fixtures headline Tuesday’s European action, with both Premier League sides seeking important victories to strengthen their positions in the league phase. Arsenal, who currently occupy third position with 10 points from four matches, will be looking to maintain their impressive European run when they welcome Dortmund to the Emirates Stadium. Mikel Arteta’s side have recorded three victories and a draw in their opening four Champions League matches, beating Napoli, Lille and Slavia Prague before playing out a 2-2 draw against Bayern Munich. The Gunners, however, will be without goalkeeper David Raya, who sustained a shoulder injury during their recent encounter with Newcastle United. Bukayo Saka and Martin Zubimendi are also listed among their unavailable players ahead of the Dortmund clash. Dortmund, meanwhile, arrive in London in good form after moving to the top of the Bundesliga with a 1-0 victory over Borussia Monchengladbach at the weekend. The German side have also won three of their four Champions League matches, beating Real Betis, Sabah and Villarreal, although they suffered a 1-0 defeat to Bodo/Glimt. They currently sit one point behind Arsenal and will be hoping to close the gap with a positive result in London. The encounter will also offer an interesting reunion for Arsenal youngster Ethan Nwaneri, who is spending the season on loan at Dortmund and is eligible to feature against his parent club. Meanwhile, Manchester City will welcome Napoli in another important encounter at the Etihad Stadium. Enzo Maresca’s side occupy seventh position with nine points, while Napoli are 27th with three points after winning just one of their opening four matches. City head into the fixture after a 1-1 draw against Fulham in the Premier League, having struggled for consistency in recent domestic outings. They will, however, take confidence from their 3-2 victory over RB Leipzig in their previous Champions League fixture as they look to strengthen their chances of securing automatic qualification for the round of 16. City will be without Antoine Semenyo, who is sidelined with a knee injury, while Matheus Nunes remains a doubt. For Napoli, the trip to Manchester presents an opportunity to revive their European campaign after defeats to Arsenal, Villarreal and Porto. The Italian side secured a 1-0 victory over Torino in Serie A at the weekend but face a difficult assignment against Guardiola’s men. Former Manchester City midfielder Kevin De Bruyne is expected to feature for Napoli, adding another interesting storyline to the encounter. item.title: Bayern score ‘own goal’ as Musiala firestorm builds
item.description: Already ravaged by injuries, Bayern Munich head to Lille in the Champions League on Wednesday swept up in a firestorm of their own making over star midfielder Jamal Musiala. Currently 13th in the table, Bayern need points if they are to reach the top eight and avoid a punishing extra knockout round. While Lille are languishing in 35th spot, last season’s semi-finalists Bayern limp into the clash despite being one of the leading contenders. Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane was the latest to join Bayern’s bulging casualty ward with an ankle injury on Friday which will likely rule him out until February. But while Musiala returned after a two-month absence in last week’s match, club bosses were accused of launching a coordinated effort to pressure the midfielder into accepting a pay cut. That the club decided to kick-start the furore a day before announcing record revenues of close to a billion euros has not gone unnoticed. – ‘Own goal’ – In August, Musiala revealed he was suffering from a “neurological disorder” which can lead to “temporary but treatable seizures”, having collapsed twice on the field in pre-season. After his return, club powerbroker Karl-Heinz Rummenigge told German TV the 23-year-old midfielder was unlikely to recapture his previous form due to the condition — and should consider taking a pay cut. “If he doesn’t return to being the Jamal of old, then we need to have a conversation with his family, with the player, and, above all, with his agency — because, frankly, the current financial figures would no longer be justifiable,” Rummenigge told Sky Germany. Rummenigge’s statements were striking but echoed those made by former president and fellow powerbroker Uli Hoeness, along with current CEO Jan-Christian Dreesen. On Sunday, player union FIFPRO slammed Bayern, accusing the club of a “coordinated campaign to put pressure on Musiala and his representatives” to accept a wage cut. “A club of Bayern’s standing should know better,” FIFPRO said in a statement. FIFPRO’s German counterparts VDV joined the chorus on Monday, saying the comments would “leave a lasting impression” on Musiala and on the club in general. “I believe those in charge have scored a real ‘own goal’ here,” VDV president Carsten Ramelow said in a statement. World Cup and Ballon d’Or winner Lothar Matthaeus, who has never been afraid to butt heads with Hoeness and the Bayern brass, said the club should provide Musiala with “every bit of support.” “Right now, everything is being placed on Musiala’s shoulders,” Matthaeus told RTL. “Perhaps all parties can sit down and talk later at a more opportune moment,” he added. – An opportunity for Musiala – For their part, Bayern coach Vincent Kompany and powerful sporting director Max Eberl have thrown their support behind Musiala publicly. Kompany, who himself returned on Friday from a month out after being hospitalised with meningeal irritation in October, backed Musiala. “The coach must be the one to believe in the player. And if

item.title: 3 biggest takeaways for Sixers following home loss to Trail Blazers
item.description: PHILADELPHIA -- The Philadelphia 76ers played host to the Portland Trail Blazers on Monday night looking to keep things moving in the right direction. Unfortunately, a lack of size and 3-point production did them in as the Sixers fell to the Blazers 128-111 to fall to 14-4 on the season. LeBron James had 23 points, six rebounds, and three assists for Philadelphia while Brown had 20 points in his return from a hamstring strain. Tyrese Maxey had 22 points and five assists, VJ Edgecombe had 12 points, seven assists, and seven rebounds, and Jabari Walker had 10 points and five rebounds. Here are the three biggest takeaways for the Sixers following the loss: Lack of size in the paint This one can be filed under the "Well, duh" category, but without Joel Embiid, who was sidelined with an illness, it was a struggle for the Sixers against a taller Trail Blazers team. Portland won the rebounding battle 49-33 led by Donovan Clingan's 18 rebounds and the Blazers were able to have a ton of success on the offensive end due to the size advantage. One has to give Walker credit for giving it his all. It was obvious that he was ready to battle and do what he had to do, but he can't help the size mismatch with Clingan and Co. in Portland. "I think the biggest challenge is just how much help you can provide," Walker said after the loss. "Sometimes when the guards get downhill, it makes you question whether you can help and then get back. So that’s always in your mind when a guy like that is on the floor." Brown's foul trouble Brown looked phenomenal to start the night as he scored 19 points on 8-for-10 shooting in the first half as Philadelphia was able to keep up with Portland. However, Brown picked up his fourth foul early in the third quarter and had to sit the rest of the third, returned in the fourth, and just could not find his rhythm again. He only scored one point on 0-for-4 shooting and he knocked down a free-throw in the second half for his only offensive contributions. The 5-time All-Star was able to give Philadelphia an offensive threat, but the foul trouble really slowed him after halftime as the Trail Blazers took control. "I wasn't too happy about it," Brown said. "It’s over with now. I think that affected the game. It also affected my rhythm a little bit in the second half. I sit the whole third quarter and coming back off injury, coming back from hamstring. Just my body didn't really feel the same after that." The 3-point discrepancy Another big issue was the 3-point difference for both teams. The Sixers shot 9-for-33 from deep while the Blazers knocked down 19 on 42 attempts on the night. That 30-point difference is tough to make up for anybody, but especially for a Sixers team that had to play small with Embiid sidelined. Philadelphia not only couldn't make up for the rebounding and paint differences, but it also couldn't figure out the 3-point line either. Afterward, coach Nick Nurse stated: Well, I think that first of all, they outplayed us. Th

item.title: Kolo Toure: ‘De Bruyne didn’t want to leave City, McTominay has been a surprise’
item.description: Kolo Toure: ‘De Bruyne didn’t want to leave City, McTominay has been a surprise’ Former Manchester City defender and assistant coach Kolo Toure says that Kevin De Bruyne never wanted to leave the Premier League side and says that he will want to show the fans that he is still at the top of his game when he returns to the Etihad Stadium on Tuesday night, and admits that Scott McTominay’s form in Serie A has been a surprise. The Ivorian, who served as an assistant to Pep Guardiola at City last season and was also part of Roberto Mancini’s Premier League winning squad in 2011-12, spoke to La Gazzetta dello Sport ahead of the meeting between Napoli and Manchester City in the Champions League on Tuesday night. NEWCASTLE UPON TYNE, ENGLAND – JANUARY 13: Manchester City assistant manager Kolo Toure looks on during the Carabao Cup Semi Final First Leg match between Newcastle United and Manchester City at St James’ Park on January 13, 2026 in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. (Photo by Michael Regan/Getty Images) Napoli head to the Etihad under pressure in the Champions League with just three points to their name from their first four matches of the competition in 2026-27, leaving them at risk of missing out on qualification for the knock-out rounds. There will be returns to Manchester for a number of Napoli players, including Man City legend De Bruyne, as well as former Manchester United stars McTominay and Rasmus Hojlund, all expected to start on the night. Toure on Man City vs. Napoli, De Bruyne and McTominay Asked how he sees Tuesday night’s game going, Toure told La Gazzetta dello Sport: “City will try to control the game and crush Napoli, and I think Allegri will set up with a compact team, careful in defence but ready to explode on the counter-attack, which could be dangerous. City will have to avoid those.” MANCHESTER, ENGLAND – SEPTEMBER 18: Jeremy Doku of Manchester City scores his team’s second goal past Vanja Milinkovic-Savic of Napoli during the UEFA Champions League 2025/26 League Phase MD1 match between Manchester City and SSC Napoli at City of Manchester Stadium on September 18, 2025 in Manchester, England. (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) Asked what City can do to prevent being hit on the counter, Toure said: “Two ways. The first is to start by pressing opponents immediately after losing the ball. The second is to have players fast enough on the pitch to get back into defensive positions once the counter-attack starts.” Toure was asked for his thoughts on De Bruyne. The Belgian superstar is into the final year of his contract with Napoli and there have been reports that he could look to leave as early as January. “Kevin was one of the best players in the history of the Premier League,” said Toure. “He is an incredible player, but more than anything, a great person. For me, what counts in football is what you do on the pitch, but what you do off it is also extremely important. Kevin is a champion in that respect. DE BRUYNE, ITALY – NOVEMBE

item.title: NFL Week 12 Power Rankings: You decide
The line between sports hero and gambling shill is fast disappearing
item.description: LeBron James will make $15m a year from his deal with Polymarket. Photograph: Matt Slocum/AP When Giannis Antetokounmpo announced he was taking an investment stake in prediction market Kalshi in February, the claim he made to accompany the announcement – “We all on Kalshi now” – sounded as absurd as the howls of outrage from sports lovers seemed universal. Nine months later, Kalshi’s grip on American fans appears murderously tight: notional monthly trading volume on the platform, the majority of which is taken up by wagers on sports, increased to nearly $100bn in October from $40bn in August, as the company gears up for yet another funding round at a rumored valuation of $65bn ahead of a potential IPO. Rival prediction market Polymarket, which relaunched in the US late last year after regulators shut it down in 2022, has seen similar growth over recent months. However righteous the disgust from fans on social media at the deepening incursion of these odious platforms into professional sport may be, their popularity seems only to grow. More perplexing is the widening circle of athletes like Giannis who’ve thrown off whatever shame might once have come from association with these businesses and given them their full-throated support. The line between role model and shill in professional sports is now essentially non-existent. Pete Sampras, a man so private in retirement it can often seem like his entire tennis career was a collective hallucination, released an ad for Kalshi during this year’s US Open after two decades largely out of the public eye. José Mourinho trousered a brick of Kalshi cash this summer in exchange for a gambling promo during the World Cup. The prediction market machine now sponsors Jalen Brunson and Josh Hart’s Roommates Show, on which the recently crowned pair of NBA champions begin every episode dutifully informing us that their amazingly dreary podcast is “presented by Polymarket, the top prediction market”. LeBron James will make more from his recently announced partnership with Polymarket – $15m a year – than he will from playing for the Philadelphia 76ers. Somehow we’ve arrived at the point where it’s bigger news if a professional athlete takes a firm stand against the prediction markets, as Victor Wembanyama recently did , rather than pockets the cash to endorse them. Related: Victor Wembanyama said no to gambling money. In today’s NBA, that feels radical Giannis, Sampras, Mourinho, LeBron: these are all wealthy individuals with giant reputations to protect. What exactly is going on here? Surely whatever money is on offer from these platforms is functionally immaterial to these men’s bank balances; surely the predicticoin is not worth the cultural damage that comes from being associated with an industry that’s seen as a symptom of professional sport’s moral rot. Or is it? Is the money really too good to refuse? Has the contest for attention in modern sport and culture become so furious that even famed recluses like Sampr

item.title: New Man Utd boss Mauricio Pochettino eyes summer raid on Borussia Dortmund for frustrated 17-year-old USMNT wonderkid
item.description: United States v Peru - International Friendly - Getty Images Sport New Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino is reportedly eyeing a summer raid on Borussia Dortmund for frustrated 17-year-old USMNT wonderkid Mathis Albert. Having previously worked with the highly-rated attacker while coaching the United States, the Argentine could offer him a route to Old Trafford if his limited minutes in Germany continue. Pochettino monitors frustrated Dortmund teenager According to Sky Germany , Pochettino could push United to sign Albert amid his lack of regular action at Dortmund. The 17-year-old attacking talent has been restricted to just 128 minutes across three appearances this season, sparking dissatisfaction over his sporting situation. He was handed a rare outing on Saturday, coming off the bench in the 72nd minute of Dortmund's 1-0 win over Borussia Monchengladbach . Argentine admires young American attacker Pochettino knows Albert's qualities well, having nurtured the youngster early on and handed him his senior call-up during his spell as United States head coach. Following his recent appointment at Old Trafford , the connection between the two has gained fresh momentum as the Red Devils plan for the future. The report states that Pochettino remains a big admirer of his former international charge and believes "Albert needs to play" to fulfil his potential. Should the teenager's situation in the Bundesliga fail to improve over the coming months, the Argentine coach could offer him the chance to earn more regular first-team minutes in England. Teenager already broke USMNT record Widely regarded as one of Dortmund's brightest academy prospects, Albert is still waiting for a genuine senior breakthrough in Germany. Across all competitions, he has made four first-team appearances for BVB, with his only start to date coming in the first round of the DFB Cup back in early September. At international level, however, he has already collected five caps for the United States. On September 30, 2026, he netted in a 4-2 win over Chile at 17 years and 131 days old to become the USMNT's youngest-ever goalscorer in just his second outing, though Cavan Sullivan broke that mark four days later against Mexico aged 17 years and six days. Summer window could prove decisive A winter transfer is currently off the table, with the German outlet noting that Albert wants to see how the rest of the campaign unfolds first. He will closely monitor his playing time at Dortmund over the next few months before deciding on his next step. If his frustration persists, Pochettino and United are poised to make a concrete summer move.

item.title: ‘Ick,’ ‘That Body Language Says It All’ — Commanders Fans Take Issue With Ja’Marr Chase’s Assessment of Why Bengals Lost on MNF
item.description: ‘Ick,’ ‘That Body Language Says It All’ — Commanders Fans Take Issue With Ja’Marr Chase’s Assessment of Why Bengals Lost on MNF Ja’Marr Chase and the Cincinnati Bengals entered Monday’s game with a five-game winning streak and were looking to improve their 7-2 record. However, Washington produced a late comeback to secure the 22-20 win. The loss ended Cincinnati’s winning run and dropped the team to 7-3 this season. Chase had been enjoying a magnificent season heading into the MNF matchup, but the Commanders’ defense managed to keep the wide receiver largely quiet. Meanwhile, Chase’s reaction to the Bengals’ loss to the Commanders also earned him jabs from fans. Commanders Fans Question Ja’Marr Chase’s Confidence After Washington Silences Bengals Chase was coming off a phenomenal 231-yard outing against the Pittsburgh Steelers in Week 10. However, he finished against Washington with just five receptions for 31 yards on nine targets, without a touchdown, ranking No. 2 in PFN’s WR Impact Score with a grade of 96.1 through Week 11. Following the Bengals’ loss and his own underwhelming performance, Chase was asked about the most difficult aspect of coming away from a loss. “Losing when you know you’re better. That’s the worst.” Chase said , according to Mike Petraglia. Commanders fans used the chance to poke fun at Chase. “Ja’Marr Chase has never beaten the Washington Commanders in his entire career, idk what type of pedestal he thinks the Bengals are compared to the Commanders,” a fan said . SET YOUR LINEUPS: PFN’s Free Fantasy Start/Sit Optimizer “0-2 btw… Higgins and Burrow 0-3 vs DC,” one said . “Whew.. that body language says it all,” one added . Washington’s defensive approach also played a significant role in limiting Cincinnati’s offensive production. The Commanders entered the game with one of the highest blitz rates in the NFL and continued to apply pressure to Joe Burrow throughout. The Commanders sacked Burrow three times, while the Bengals receiving duo of Chase and Tee Higgins combined for only seven catches for 74 yards. Commanders fans had reason to challenge Chase’s assessment because Cincinnati has now lost its last three meetings against Washington. PREDICT THE NFL SEASON: PFN’s Free NFL Playoff Predictor “ICKKKKK,” another said . “The Bengals ranked 2nd in EPA/play and success rate entering MNF. The marks they achieved on MNF would have the following ranks for the season: EPA/play – 17th, success rate – 28th. Perhaps the better team didn’t hit it’s usual standard against a defense missing three starter,” Grant Mitchell, host of the ‘Full Command Show,’ wrote . “You are 0-2 against us and Burrow is 0-3. Know your place, one added . The Bengals will now look to bounce back when they return home to face the New Orleans Saints in Week 12. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: MiLaysia Fulwiley Treated to Big Ovation From LSU Fans as Lady Tigers Star Hits 1,500 Career Points in Return After Arrest
item.description: MiLaysia Fulwiley ©IMAGO/Newscom World After piling up 17 steals and 11 blocks across her first four games, MiLaysia Fulwiley spent two outings on the sideline while unbeaten LSU rolled on without her. Nine days after her arrest in Baton Rouge, another question surrounded the senior guard’s return to the Pete Maravich Assembly Center against Belmont: How would LSU fans respond? Once she stepped back onto the floor, Monday night delivered far more than an ordinary return to the rotation. During LSU’s home matchup against Belmont on November 23, 2026, in Baton Rouge, Fulwiley checked in off the bench with 4:37 remaining in the first quarter and the Tigers already ahead 13–0. Covering the game courtside for the USA TODAY Network, reporter Cory Diaz documented the crowd’s response on X as MiLaysia Fulwiley made her first appearance in 10 days: “MiLaysia Fulwiley gets a big ovation from the #LSU fans here in the PMAC.” The warm welcome captured in Cory Diaz’s X post opened a productive night for Fulwiley, who returned from her two-game absence following a November 14 arrest to finish with 14 points, five steals, and 1,500 career points in LSU’s 103–45 win over Belmont. Later in the fourth quarter, with 1:35 remaining and LSU up 100–42, the arena video board honored the scoring milestone in a separate moment shared on X by reporter Andre Champagne. From the bench, MiLaysia Fulwiley waved and flashed a hand heart toward the cheering crowd while teammates celebrated around her. A comeback moment and a historic milestone converge as MiLaysia Fulwiley reclaims her place on LSU's biggest stage. Subscribe for the latest on college basketball's most compelling stories. What MiLaysia Fulwiley’s Return Means for LSU After Two Games Out The night closed a turbulent stretch that began on November 14, when Fulwiley was arrested following a traffic-control encounter with police after LSU’s football game against Texas. Authorities initially booked her on two felony counts—aggravated battery and aggravated assault with a dangerous weapon—alongside three misdemeanor counts related to fleeing, resisting, and disobeying officers over alleged conduct during the stop. While the situation remained under review, she sat out LSU’s home wins over Troy on November 16 and Fairleigh Dickinson on November 19. Her path back opened on November 20, when East Baton Rouge Parish prosecutors dismissed both felony charges while referring the three misdemeanor counts to a pretrial diversion program rather than dismissing every matter outright. That same day, Fulwiley issued an apology through LSU acknowledging the night never should have happened and that her posts afterward made matters worse, apologizing to the officers, her family, and Tiger fans while focusing on earning back trust. Following a reported return to practice on November 21, LSU confirmed her availability ahead of Belmont . item.title: Enzo Maresca has said Abdukodir Khusanov is better suited to centre-back than right-back as Manchester City weigh up their options ahead of the 2027 January transfer window.
item.description: Enzo Maresca has said Abdukodir Khusanov is better suited to centre-back than right-back as Manchester City weigh up their options ahead of the 2027 January transfer window. Right-back has been area of concern for Manchester City's leaky defence of late. More Videos Maresca has used Matheus Nunes as his first-choice right-back this season and the Portugal international is back in contention after an ankle problem kept him out of Saturday's 1-1 draw with Fulham . Abdukodir Khusanov started at right-back in Nunes' absence against Fulham, with Rodrigo Muniz getting the better of the Uzbekistan international for the opening goal before Elliot Anderson volleyed in a second-half equaliser. Maresca discusses Man City's right-back prospects ahead of Napoli test Speaking in a press conference ahead of Tuesday's UEFA Champions League clash with Napoli, Maresca discussed his options at right-back following strong criticism aimed at the Blues' backline after a poor run of Premier League results. The Manchester City manager said: "Since we started, we've used Rico [Lewis] there, but also [Abdukodir] Khusa, that I think he can play there. For sure, it's much better - I'm trying to find the right balance. "If you ask me if Khusa [Khusanov] is a better right-back or central defender, no doubt: Central defender. I know that. But it's a matter of the game, the players we have available. "But Matheus [Nunes] has done very good since we started, the games he has played, overall he was very good." City have been linked with Villarreal right-back Alex Freeman ahead of the January window, with sporting director Hugo Viana having overseen a major squad overhaul since Maresca's arrival in June. Freeman, a 22-year-old United States international who joined Villarreal from Orlando City in January, is said to be open to a move to the Etihad Stadium - and he can also play at centre-back. Maresca also pointed out on Monday that City had conceded seven goals from chances worth around three expected goals across their four-game winless run in the Premier League. It's just a matter of getting to know each other, says Maresca on Man City squad ahead of January window Maresca then explained that he is still getting to know his players, having witnessed a significant overhaul of the first-team dressing room since he replaced Pep Guardiola at the helm in June. "It's just a matter to know each other, I need to understand how is the idea one for these kind of games, the idea one for different kinds of games," the 46-year-old added. "I don't think it's just [the] midfield, also we are trying with defensive players to find the right solution. Again, it's for me part of the process because it's like a reset, a restart, after 10 years with the same manager, same face, same words, same method. "It's not easy to all of sudden change. For me personally, it's all normal, and hopefully as soon as possible we can find the right balance in all the lines - defensive, midfield - and we can be cons

item.title: Relief for Arsenal as Raya has not suffered a serious injury
item.description: Relief for Arsenal as Raya has not suffered a serious injury Arsenal have received a major boost after David Raya’s injury proved less serious than initially feared, with the goalkeeper potentially returning to action this weekend. The Spaniard was forced off against Newcastle United after suffering a suspected shoulder injury , leaving the club concerned about his availability for upcoming matches. Raya appeared to be in considerable discomfort following the incident and did not look comfortable as he made his way off the pitch. His reaction immediately raised concerns among Arsenal supporters, who feared the goalkeeper could face a lengthy spell on the sidelines. The club arranged for him to undergo scans after the match to establish the extent of the problem. Fortunately, the results did not reveal any serious damage, giving Arsenal encouragement that their first-choice goalkeeper could return much sooner than expected. Arteta provides encouraging injury update Raya is one of Arsenal’s most important players and has established himself as one of the leading goalkeepers in world football. Losing him for an extended period would have been a significant setback for Mikel Arteta’s side as they look to build on their success from last season. However, the latest assessment suggests the situation is not as concerning as it initially appeared. Raya will miss the Borussia Dortmund match, but there is now hope that he could be available again at the weekend. Speaking to Arsenal Media ahead of the Champions League fixture, Arteta provided an update on the goalkeeper’s condition and explained why the initial reaction had been worrying. He said: “He’s not fit for tomorrow unfortunately, but it doesn’t look too serious. We need some more tests tomorrow, but it’s quite encouraging. “With the pain that he was showing immediately after the action, we were all quite worried, but he seems to be better than we expected. When you look at the action, it doesn’t seem to be much on it, but the extent of the pain that he had and how he was struggling, it was quite worrying.” (Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images) Arsenal hope Raya returns quickly The Gunners will continue monitoring Raya before deciding when he can return. His availability would be a welcome boost, particularly with important fixtures approaching. Although Arsenal must manage without him against Dortmund, Arteta will be encouraged by the progress so far. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ ADMIN COMMENT So here are some simple rules which I must insist commenters follow…. item.title: ‘One of us’ – NFL fans praise Pat McAfee after hilarious reaction to Jason Kelce on MNF
item.description: Photo by Scott Taetsch/Getty Images ESPN’s Monday Night Football coverage has taken a lot of criticism this season, with Joe Buck and Troy Aikman’s saga being one of the big talking points. However, ESPN’s pre-game show and alt cast, including the controversial Pat McAfee, have also proven incredibly divisive. Despite a lot of fans having vented their frustrations with McAfee throughout the season, a lot of people loved what they saw him doing during this week’s show. Jason Kelce has also split the opinions of the viewers on ESPN, which left many fans on Monday night enjoying McAfee not paying any attention at all to the former Philadelphia Eagles centre. NFL fans provide rare praise towards Pat McAfee during Monday Night Football McAfee has been pushed considerably by ESPN over a number of different programmes, with the former Indianapolis Colts punter being made to earn every cent he is being paid by the network. ‘Pat McAfee isn’t even listening to Jason Kelce. One of us!’ one fan said on X during the pre-game show on Monday Night Football. Another fan replied: ‘And why would u? Jason Kelce just commented that Jayden Daniels has been so flawless in two-minute & end-of-game scenarios this season.’ It is rare to see McAfee earn the praise of the viewers, with many still feeling as if he is being given way too much airtime by ESPN. Alongside his own show during the week, McAfee is also presenting College Gameday and the Monday Night Football alt cast. ‘For 2027, ESPN should make its MNF broadcasters Joe Buck and Pat McAfee,’ said another NFL fan. McAfee has been known for being incredibly charitable, and alongside the NFL, he is now giving away Super Bowl tickets in a pre-game kickoff catch game. This is a feature which has also gone down extremely well with viewers on ESPN. ‘Don’t love his show, but Pat McAfee is changing folks’ lives weekly. I do appreciate that,’ one fan said on X. McAfee also made a $25,000 donation to The GR8 Chase charity ahead of kickoff as a result of the kickoff catch competition, which provided the fan with tickets to the Super Bowl at SoFi Stadium. ‘Pat McAfee gives away MILLIONS to charity,’ replied another. item.title: Brandel Chamblee loved what Marco Penge did after sealing victory at The RSM Classic
item.description: Photo by Jonathan Bachman/Getty Images Brandel Chamblee has heaped praise on the way Marco Penge reacted to the moment he sealed victory at The RSM Classic following a four-man playoff at Sea Island. Penge ended a turbulent season on a real high at the final event of the year on the PGA Tour. The Englishman was one of the raft of players outside the top 100 in the FedEx Cup standings heading into The RSM Classic. Penge made four birdies on the back nine on Monday to move himself to 16 under par for the tournament. That saw the three-time DP World Tour winner secure a spot in a playoff with Max Greyserman, Haotong Li, and Michael Thorbjornsen. Penge was the only player to make a birdie on the first extra hole. That was enough to not only land his first PGA Tour victory, but also move Penge up to 64th in the FedEx Cup. With that, he has secured his full card for 2027 and a ticket to the Championship Series the following year. Brandel Chamblee praises Marco Penge after his RSM Classic win It was a somewhat muted celebration from Penge when he got across the line. And Brandel Chamblee believes that it was a touch of class from the 28-year-old. Taking to X , Chamblee suggested that Penge was mindful of celebrating in the face of those who endured heartbreak at the season finale. He wrote: ‘ What an emotional ride that playoff was at RSM…. Imagine being John Parry who 3-putted the last hole on Friday to miss the cut and fell outside the projected top 100 rankings and watching the 4 way playoff knowing: If Haotong Li won, you would lose your card. If Haotong Li lost, you would keep your card. On the flip side, if Haotong Li won, Li would keep his card. If Haotong Li lost the playoff, Li would lose his card. ‘ And love the way Penge won; birdieing the last in regulation and then again on the first playoff hole… but not being demonstrably happy when his put fell to win, because it seemed to me, he knew there were people who lost more than the tournament because he won .’ Marco Penge explains how he felt going into the playoff at Sea Island As Chamblee notes, the stakes were extremely high for the likes of Penge and Haotong Li. While finishing outside the top 100 is not a disaster, those players would have been looking for every advantage possible ahead of the big changes coming in from 2028. It has been a hugely difficult time for Penge on and off the course. So you would imagine that he will be extremely pleased to see the back of this season. And that may explain why he felt relaxed heading into the playoff, having finally secured some clarity on what he can look to do in 2027. “I think from there I was so anxious or so over the moon to finish in the top-100, have a great week here at the RSM Classic regardless, the playoff felt like a bit of a bonus,” he said, reflecting on being tied at the top at the end of the final round. “I felt really chill. Spoke to a couple of mates back home while I was in the buggy up to the tee. Yeah, just knew it was kind o

item.title: Barcelona declare in-form midfielder untouchable amid Chelsea and Manchester United interest
item.description: Barcelona declare in-form midfielder untouchable amid Chelsea and Manchester United interest According to Fabrizio Romano (h/t SPORT ), Barcelona have no intention of entertaining offers for Fermin Lopez amid growing interest in the in-form midfielder, particularly from the Premier League. The midfielder’s outstanding performances have attracted attention from the likes of Chelsea and Manchester United , but the Catalan giants’ position is clear: Fermin is untouchable. Not for sale Fermin’s development under Hansi Flick over the past couple of seasons has been remarkable. He has become one of Barcelona’s most influential players, thanks to his energy, relentless pressing and the goal threat he offers from the attacking midfield position. This season alone, the 23-year-old La Masia graduate has registered a tally of nine goals and seven assists from 16 games across all competitions, and is only behind Raphinha and Lamine Yamal in the team’s scoring charts. In top form. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Fermin has now found the back of the net in consecutive games, having scored both of Barcelona’s goals against Atletico Madrid and then netted the equaliser in the team’s 3-2 comeback win over Villarreal last Sunday. Given his meteoric rise, interest from the Premier League has intensified. Chelsea had already made approaches for Fermin during the summer of 2025 and remain on the lookout, while Manchester United have also expressed an interest. But, as far as Barcelona are concerned, they have no plans to open negotiations over a potential departure for the 23-year-old star. While they recognise the potential financial return from selling a player of Fermin’s profile, the Blaugrana believe his importance on the pitch outweighs any immediate economic benefit. Fermin also wants to stay Meanwhile, Fermin himself has no desire to leave Barcelona, having penned a long-term contract with the club in January, committing his future until the summer of 2029. Not for sale. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Having come through the club’s academy, the Spanish midfielder wants to continue progressing at the club establish himself as one of the leading figures in the team. The 23-year-old is also protected by a mammoth release clause of €500 million as part of the new deal he signed earlier this year. But the report states that Barcelona could revisit his contract once the current season concludes, when he will have only two years left on his current one. Either way, the intention of both the player and the club is to continue their partnership for a long time.
